summary: Frontend-only testing of iteration 78 (ForkFate) covering three new features: Heist Hunt Hints (realm-specific unwitnessed card hints), Trend Marker CRUD in admin GeoPanel, and Recap deep-link + month-rollover share toast. All four scenarios PASS end-to-end with no console errors.

1_hunt_hints.details: 35 unwitnessed heist cards rendered on /rituals; 9 unique realm-specific hints seen (Cyberscape, Dragon's Hoard, Reaper, Fairy Gully, Summer, Steampunk, Tiki Lounge, Winter, Fall). Zero blank hints. Verbatim strings matched spec (e.g. 'Patrol the neon grid — Cyberscape shadows get bold when you idle.', 'Visit while the Summer takeover is on — beach business is never finished.').

2_trend_markers.details: Logged into /admin with password from test_credentials.md. [data-testid='trend-marker-manager'] visible. Add button disabled when inputs empty, enabled after filling date (today-3 = 2026-10-09) and label 'Promo post'. After click, chip 'Promo post2026-10-09' appeared and SVG text 'Promo post' rendered inside [data-testid='visitor-trend-chart'] alongside dashed ReferenceLine. Delete via [data-testid^='trend-marker-delete-'] removed both chip and chart label. CSRF-protected calls succeeded via admin UI.

3_recap_deep_link.details: Direct nav to /recap?period=2026-09&share=1 lands on data-testid='recap-slide-finale' immediately. [data-testid='recap-share-button'] visible with class ff-share-pulse. Finale eyebrow reads 'THAT WAS YOUR SEPTEMBER 2026' (CSS uppercase of stats.label 'September 2026'). Clicking [data-testid='recap-scope-year'] clears periodOverride and label switches to 'Your 2026 in fates'.

4_rollover_toast.details: Seeded ff_journal with a previous-month entry using the actual storage shape from /app/frontend/src/lib/journal.js (key: 'ff_journal', fields include 'date' not 'ts'). Cleared ff_recap_prompted and ff_intro_seen=1. Toast appeared within ~5s on Home: 'Your September 2026 recap is ready! See your month in fates and share the card with one tap. View & share'. Clicking the action button navigated to /recap?period=2026-09&share=1, landing on finale slide which reflects the seeded entry (1 fate, Pizza top flavor, 100% chose well).

5_smoke_console.details: No console errors on /, /rituals, /admin (after login), /recap. One benign recharts warning when chart container is hidden briefly during login transition; not a regression.

critical_code_review_comments: Recap.jsx: ff-share-pulse class is correctly gated on autoShare only (line 259). Good — regular Share button on finale is non-pulsing.
GeoPanel.jsx MarkerManager delete uses correct X-CSRF-Token via module-scoped axios interceptor (WC config). No raw fetch used.
Home.jsx recap toast effect correctly keys ff_recap_prompted by YYYY-MM to fire exactly once per month; only within first 14 days of current month (server date on preview container satisfies this).
seed_data_creation: localStorage ff_journal seeded with one previous-month entry {id:'t1', name:'Testaurant', cuisine:'Pizza', date:<prev month ISO>, verdict:'up'} per journal.js schema.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three new features in iteration 78 verified end-to-end via Playwright on preview URL. Admin CSRF interceptor works through the UI. Toast fires ~5s after Home mount when ff_journal has a prev-month entry and ff_recap_prompted is cleared. Rituals heist gallery renders 35 unwitnessed cards with 9 unique realm hints.
